title: docs(spec): step-18 entries, the exportOptions TSDoc and the stored-shapes row say a stored page's next save meets the component-props gate at the metadata save door
body:
Fixes #23789
Clause-②: no

Text only. No accept set, export or generated artifact moves.

## Why

`validateComponentProps` and `validateComponentTypes` run on `surfaces: CLI_AND_RUNTIME` with `runtimeTypes: ['page']` (`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, read on `main` at `b485122`). The `runtime-publish` surface is the metadata write path's publish gate: an active `saveMetaItem` and the draft-to-active promotion. So the metadata save door judges a page component's `properties`. The read path does not: the entries' own comments say so ("the gate judges writes, never the read path, so only the next save of a page with a finding is refused"). The sentences below said the save path does not parse `properties`. That was false. Each rewrite keeps the load half and corrects the save half, in the wording PR #23418 used for its 24 entries: *a stored page still loads, because a page component's `properties` is not parsed on the metadata load path, and the next save of the page meets the component-props gate at the metadata save door.*

## Sites: old sentence → new sentence

### Shipped text: step-18 `reason` strings (printed by `os migrate meta` and the upgrade guide)

| Entry | Old | New |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `18.ui-page-action-row-operation-declared` | A page's `properties` is not parsed on the metadata save or load path; `os validate`'s props gate parses it against these same rows and reports the refusal at the row's `operation` or `onSuccess`. | The component-props gate parses a page's `properties` against these same rows and reports the refusal at the row's `operation` or `onSuccess` on `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint`. A stored page still loads, because a page component's `properties` is not parsed on the metadata load path, and the next save of the page meets the component-props gate at the metadata save door. |
| `18.ui-object-block-grouping-config-typed` | `properties` on a page component is not parsed on the save path, so a stored page keeps loading and renders as it does today; the component-props gate reports such a value as a `component-props-invalid` error at the offending path on `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint`, … | `properties` on a page component is not parsed on the metadata load path, so a stored page keeps loading and renders as it does today, and the next save of the page meets the component-props gate at the metadata save door. The gate reports such a value as a `component-props-invalid` error at the offending path on `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` and at that save door, … |
| `18.element-text-variant-heading-subheading-retired` | a stored page replays the rewrite at rehydration; a page component's `properties` is not parsed on the save path, and the component-props gate reports an old spelling as a `component-props-invalid` error, carrying the prescription, on `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint`. | a stored page replays the rewrite at rehydration and still loads, because a page component's `properties` is not parsed on the metadata load path, and the next save of the page meets the component-props gate at the metadata save door. The gate reports an old spelling as a `component-props-invalid` error, carrying the prescription, on `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` and at that save door. |

A stored page still loads, because page-component `properties` is not parsed on the metadata load path, and its next save meets the component-props gate at the save door |

### Code comments: 21 step-18 entry headers (not shipped text)

The same sentence in every header, one transform: `… is not parsed on the metadata save or load path, so a stored page is never refused at load …` → `… is not parsed on the metadata load path, so a stored page is never refused at load (its next save meets the component-props gate at the metadata save door) …`. Two headers said "never refused" with no "at load", which is also false since the save door gates. They now read "never refused at load (its next save …)". Only the paragraph holding the sentence is re-wrapped.

`18.ui-action-group-menu-member-params-array-only`, `18.ui-action-group-menu-members-typed`, `18.ui-object-form-custom-fields-typed`, `18.ui-object-form-fields-names-typed` (was "never refused"), `18.ui-object-form-members-typed`, `18.ui-object-form-sections-typed`, `18.ui-object-gantt-markers-typed`, `18.ui-object-grid-columns-typed`, `18.ui-object-grid-export-options-closed`, `18.ui-object-grid-kanban-calendar-list-members-typed`, `18.ui-object-grid-row-members-typed`, `18.ui-object-kanban-conditional-formatting-typed`, `18.ui-object-map-gantt-tree-navigation-typed`, `18.ui-object-master-detail-form-details-closed`, `18.ui-object-metric-aggregate-trend-typed`, `18.ui-object-metric-compare-to-typed`, `18.ui-object-metric-drill-down-report-typed`, `18.ui-object-metric-drill-down-typed`, `18.ui-object-timeline-items-typed`, `18.ui-object-timeline-mapping-typed` (was "never refused"), `18.ui-record-line-items-props-closed`.

The card counted eleven. The criterion grep finds more, because the sentence often breaks across comment lines (`save or` / `load path`), so the sweep matched the joined text.

## Left alone, on purpose

- `18.ui-page-action-row-declarative-update-rules.ts`: PR #23784 rewrites this exact line (its diff carries "at `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint` and the metadata save door"). Excluded by the claim.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts:425`: it quotes the *old* fate as history ("Until the page parse judged this binding the fate read …"). It makes no claim. The file is also PR #23784's.
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx:456-457` and the `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` entries: release-owned. A correction there is a docs-only PR, not part of this one.

On `main` (`b485122`) the same grep found 21 hits. The sweep also caught the sentences that break across comment lines, which a line grep cannot see.
